info.title: emasuriano.com public API
info.description: Read-only JSON for Ema Suriano's profile, posts, talks, and projects. No authentication. Versioning: /api/v1 is the stable surface; unversioned /api/summary and /api/posts are aliases of v1. Breaking changes will be introduced as /api/v2 and advertised with Deprecation and Sunset response headers. Rate limit: 60 requests per 60 seconds. Errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a machine-readable code.

get.description: Canonical machine-readable profile: name, bio, website, projects, talks, and posts.
